its Z is signed for A2, not A1: at the 1,727 SNPs with |Z| > 4 in both, it is opposite to the Z of {PANUKBB_EverSmoked} every time, and at 1,939 to that of {UKB_460K.cov_SMOKING_STATUS}; rg -1.00 and -0.99 with them

its Z is signed for A2, like {PASS_SmokingInitiation_Liu2019} of the same paper: opposite to the Z of {PANUKBB_EverSmoked} at 127 of the 132 SNPs with |Z| > 4 in both; rg -0.45 with it and -0.55 with {GCST90319877}

its Z is signed for A2, like {PASS_SmokingInitiation_Liu2019} of the same paper: opposite to the Z of {GBMI_ChronicObstructivePulmonaryDisease} at all 20 SNPs with |Z| > 4 in both; rg -0.61 with it and with {PASS_CancerLung_McKay2017}

its Z is signed for A2, like {PASS_SmokingInitiation_Liu2019} of the same paper: rg -0.57 with {PASS_CancerLung_McKay2017} and -0.56 with {GBMI_ChronicObstructivePulmonaryDisease}; opposite to the Z of the first at 23 of the 29 SNPs with |Z| > 4 in both

its Z is signed for A2, like {PASS_SmokingInitiation_Liu2019} of the same paper: rg -0.75 with that study, yet +0.72 with {PANUKBB_EverSmoked}, the same trait from another source, whose Z it follows at all 58 SNPs with |Z| > 4 in both

its Z is signed for A2: it has the sign of the Z of {PASS_DrinksPerWeek_Liu2019}, which is reversed, at all 153 SNPs with |Z| > 4 in both (rg 0.87); its rg is -0.33 with {GCST90319877} and -0.37 with {PANUKBB_EverSmoked}

its Z does not go with its alleles: at the 1,633 SNPs with |Z| > 4 in both, it has the sign of the Z of {PANUKBB_AtrialFibrillationAndFlutter} for half (50%), where two studies of one trait agree throughout; 50% of 533 against {GCST90728695}. Its rg is -0.19 and -0.01 with them, where those two have 0.54

its Z does not go with its alleles: at the SNPs with |Z| > 4 in both, it has the sign of the Z of {PASS_CoronaryArteryDisease_Aragam2022} for 54% of 210, and for all 210 once the alleles are left aside; 48% of 62 against {GBMI_Stroke}. Its rg is 0.00 and 0.05 with them, where those two have 0.76
